title: A clearer portfolio, with an engineering point of view
question: Use the Engineering Manual direction, choose a conventional portfolio, or steer the design.

options.label: The Engineering Manual
options.lineage: Industrial equipment manuals and systems catalogs
options.thesis: Your work presented with the directness and precision of a well-made engineering manual.
options.viewport: An asymmetric yellow opening with your name, role, direct contact, and a real architecture plate; project summaries follow as open rows.
options.risk: Deliberately utilitarian; the typography and real diagrams carry the character.

raised.raise: Give the architecture images real visual weight.
Keep source links adjacent to their evidence.
Make selected and expanded states unmistakable.
Make the opening reveal a real system immediately.
Commit color to whole regions rather than scattered accents.
Keep career chronology attached to the work it explains.

options.label: Print Editions
options.thesis: Repeated project images create editioned variations.
options.viewport: Repeated project images create editioned variations.
options.risk: Engineering projects are distinct systems, not variations of one subject.
options.case: Declined on audience identification and product clarity: Engineering projects are distinct systems, not variations of one subject.
options.kept: Give the architecture images real visual weight.

options.label: Reference Edition
options.thesis: Two columns of technical evidence around a keyed navigation rail.
options.viewport: Two columns of technical evidence around a keyed navigation rail.
options.risk: Dense scholarly reading delays the work and contact actions for both audiences.
options.case: Declined on audience identification and product clarity: Dense scholarly reading delays the work and contact actions for both audiences.
options.kept: Keep source links adjacent to their evidence.

options.label: Cathode Stack
options.thesis: A dark numeral-driven interface with layered glowing states.
options.viewport: A dark numeral-driven interface with layered glowing states.
options.risk: A control-panel metaphor obscures project discovery and repeats the current glow-heavy problem.
options.case: Declined on audience identification and product clarity: A control-panel metaphor obscures project discovery and repeats the current glow-heavy problem.
options.kept: Make selected and expanded states unmistakable.

options.label: Event Display
options.thesis: Projects branch from a central event through concentric layers.
options.viewport: Projects branch from a central event through concentric layers.
options.risk: The radial instrument implies relationships the independent projects do not have.
options.case: Declined on audience identification and product clarity: The radial instrument implies relationships the independent projects do not have.
options.kept: Make the opening reveal a real system immediately.

options.label: Color Counterpoint
options.thesis: Translucent bands reveal overlapping engineering disciplines.
options.viewport: Translucent bands reveal overlapping engineering disciplines.
options.risk: Color mixing offers little identification or clarity for infrastructure evaluation.
options.case: Declined on audience identification and product clarity: Color mixing offers little identification or clarity for infrastructure evaluation.
options.kept: Commit color to whole regions rather than scattered accents.

options.label: Provenance Ribbon
options.thesis: A dated line connects the evidence behind each build.
options.viewport: A dated line connects the evidence behind each build.
options.risk: A continuous ownership narrative misrepresents independent projects.
options.case: Declined on audience identification and product clarity: A continuous ownership narrative misrepresents independent projects.
options.kept: Keep career chronology attached to the work it explains.

canonCard.label: Conventional portfolio
canonCard.thesis: A familiar personal portfolio with quieter styling and straightforward project cards.
canonCard.viewport: Name and introduction above a conventional grid of project previews.
canonCard.risk: Comfortable and familiar, with less distinctive identity.
